description: Sixteen source packages provide livestock-slaughter statistics. Two XLSX summary packages describe cattle/calves, hogs and sheep/lambs in Alberta, western Canada, Canada and provinces, including annual changes and comparative shares; their rolling labels span 2004–2015 with differing intervals. Thirteen monthly PDF publication packages cover 2012–2024 and describe Canadian and United States slaughter with monthly, quarterly and year-to-date comparisons. The returned 2012 descriptors begin in June and the 2024 descriptors end in June; 2013–2023 list all twelve months. The 2019 title and descriptors conflict with native time-span fields of 2012–2018. These are food-processing throughput measures, grouped as a curated statistical family with original geographies, species and period definitions preserved. They do not identify individual plant capacity or constitute interchangeable tables. Geographic coverage is Canada, with source-specific Alberta, provincial, western Canadian or United States comparisons as described. The Canadian Urban Data Catalogue preserves the source identifiers and descriptive metadata. The native licence is Open Government Licence - Alberta. Access is labelled unrestricted but isopen is false; actual payload access and costs remain unverified. No linked dataset, workbook, document, legal text, model or code body was retrieved. Specific simulation applications beyond those explicitly described are not established. A further slaughter-processing companion reports total hog heads slaughtered in Alberta. Two XLSX summary descriptors cover 2005–2014 and 2006–2015. These extend the curated throughput family to 16 source packages, without equating marketings, annual counts, monthly reports or their different geographies.
